def _make(path, name, content="data"):
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(path, name), "w") as f:
        f.write(content)
    return os.path.join(path, name)

def test_r1_transfers_matching_extensions(tmp_path):
    src = tmp_path / "src"
    dst = tmp_path / "dst"
    _make(str(src), "a.txt")
    _make(str(src), "b.csv")
    _make(str(src), "c.log")
    result = task_func(str(src), str(dst), [".txt", ".csv"])
    assert sorted(result) == ["a.txt", "b.csv"]
    assert sorted(os.listdir(str(dst))) == ["a.txt", "b.csv"]
    assert os.listdir(str(src)) == ["c.log"]

def test_r7_warns_on_untransferable_file(tmp_path):
    src = tmp_path / "src"
    dst = tmp_path / "dst"
    _make(str(src), "ok.txt")
    # a dangling symlink matching the extension cannot be transferred
    os.symlink(str(src / "missing_target"), str(src / "broken.txt"))
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        result = task_func(str(src), str(dst), [".txt"])
    assert "ok.txt" in result
